expected.summary: The March 31, 2022 bidder conference date was replaced.
The bidder conference was moved to April 5, 2022 from 1:00 to 2:00 PM.
Attendance was strongly suggested rather than mandatory.
Written questions were due through COMMBUYS on April 7, 2022 at 2:00 PM EST.
The bid opening deadline was May 3, 2022 at 3:00 PM.
Responses had to be sent through COMMBUYS Create Quote.
The quote had to be signed electronically through acceptance on the Terms & Conditions tab.
Narrative responses should not exceed ten double-sided pages, excluding forms and attachments.
Provided forms had to remain in their original formats and not be converted to PDF.
Security Services bidders needed at least three years in that business.
Category 1 bidders had to attach a PDF of a current Watch Guard Manager License or Massachusetts Certification Unit certification.
Armed personnel needed a current Massachusetts Firearms License and training.
Bidders needed a pool of trained or cross-trained replacement guards for emergencies or extra coverage.
Bidders had to list three to five business references.
Attachment A had to identify covered counties or statewide coverage.
The active price workbook was Attachment B v2 dated April 8, 2022.
Attachment B pricing covered weekday/night/weekend and guard service components.
Bidders had to submit Attachment E prompt-payment terms.
Attachment D was required and the minimum acceptable SDP commitment was 1 percent.
At least 25 percent of the 100 evaluation points were allocated to SDP Plan submissions.
Quotes had to remain in effect for at least 90 days after submission.
Standard contract and related forms were post-award and not to be submitted until requested.
